title: Hungarian Labour Market Yearbook 2012 (Fazekas–Benczúr–Telegdy eds.)
title_hu: Munkaerőpiaci Tükör 2012 (Fazekas Károly, Benczúr Péter, Telegdy Álmos szerk.)
summary_en: The 2012 edition of the Hungarian Labour Market Yearbook (Munkaerőpiaci Tükör), edited by Fazekas, Benczúr and Telegdy, surveys the state of the Hungarian labour market in the post-2008-crisis period. Standard sections cover labour-market data (employment, unemployment, wages by region and demographic group), institutional changes (taxes, transfers, public-works programme), and a thematic 'In Focus' section. The 2012 volume's thematic focus is on tax-and-transfer changes and their labour-supply effects following the 2010–11 reforms.
policy_relevance: Standard reference volume for Hungarian labour-market policy analysts (BM Foglalkoztatáspolitikai Stratégia, NGM, KSH labour-market division). The institutional summaries and tax-transfer-effects chapters provide the empirical baseline against which subsequent labour-market reforms can be evaluated.
